name: Acquisition / M&A Integration
description: Post-acquisition integration response structure. Activates when an acquisition closes or is publicly announced. Speed matters — announce org structure within 30 days, execute 100-day integration plan. Focus on cultural alignment, talent retention, and operational integration.
trigger_conditions: Acquisition deal signed and closing is imminent or completed
Asset purchase or business unit acquisition closes
Merger of equals announced and integration planning begins
Public announcement of acquisition triggers integration timeline
Reverse merger or SPAC transaction business combination closes
Majority stake acquisition requiring operational consolidation

responsibilities: Overall integration vision and strategic direction
Communicate the 'new company story' to all stakeholders
Final authority on org design decisions
Set cultural integration priorities and tone
Approve 100-day plan and major milestones
Manage board and investor expectations on integration ROI

ops_lead.role: Integration Lead (dedicated full-time role — not dual-hatted)
responsibilities: Day-to-day management of integration workstreams
Design and track 100-day integration plan with milestones
Coordinate cross-functional integration teams (engineering, sales, finance, HR, legal)
Identify and escalate integration blockers
Manage integration budget and resource allocation
Run weekly integration steering committee
Systems integration timeline — CRM, ERP, HRIS, code repos, collaboration tools
Org design — role matching, title alignment, reporting structure
[External] Brand decision — acquire, be acquired, or create new brand
[External] Customer communication — joint roadmap, product continuity, contract terms
[External] Press release strategy — announce deal, integration milestones
[External] Analyst and influencer relationship management during transition
[Internal] Employee integration communications — Day 1 email, weekly updates
[Internal] Executive visibility plan — roadshows, town halls, skip-levels
[Internal] Culture integration plan — shared values, norms, traditions
[Internal] FAQ management — every rumor addressed proactively
Antitrust/competition law compliance — ensure merger clearance conditions are met
Contract integration — assign or novate key contracts to acquiring entity
IP assignment and integration — patents, trademarks, copyrights
Employee transfer compliance — WARN Act, TUPE (UK/Europe), consultation obligations
Regulatory filings and ongoing compliance post-close
Litigation risk assessment — legacy disputes from acquired company
Corporate structure simplification — entity consolidation timeline

key_actions: 1. Day 1 ready — IT systems (email, Slack, payroll) integrated before close. Employees wake up as employees of new company
2. Announce org design within 30 days — no prolonged uncertainty. People need to know who they report to, what their title is, what their role is
3. 100-day integration plan with clear milestones — 13-week delivery focus with weekly tracking
4. Cultural assessment within first 2 weeks — intentional, led by HR. Identify integration risks (comp differences, decision-making styles, communication norms)
5. Role matching and talent mapping — every role assigned: retained, transitioned, redundant, or TBD. Be transparent about timeline for decisions
6. Retention packages for key talent from acquired company — identify top 20% within first week, offer retention equity/signing bonus before they get poached
7. Systems integration timeline — prioritize: comms (email/Slack), HR/payroll, finance/ERP, CRM, then all others. No system should remain separate beyond 90 days without good reason
8. Brand decision — acquired brand, acquiring brand, or house of brands. Make decision within 30 days and communicate rationale
9. Customer integration plan — contract migration, account management handover, product roadmap transparency. Joint customer communication within first week
10. Revenue synergy tracking — set baseline, define synergy metrics, assign owners, track monthly
11. Cross-company buddy program — pair employees from each company for mutual integration and knowledge sharing
12. Post-integration review at 100 days — what worked, what didn't, course correction for next phase

communication_protocol.internal: Day 1 all-hands from both CEOs together within 1 hour of close. Weekly integration newsletter from Integration Lead. Org design announced within 30 days. Monthly all-hands from Integration Lead and CEO. Anonymous Q&A platform for uncomfortable questions.
communication_protocol.external: Joint press release on close. Customer email within 48 hours. Analyst briefing within 2 weeks. No individual communications about integration plans before org design is finalized. Single narrative across both companies — no mixed messages.
communication_protocol.cadence: Integration Lead — weekly steering committee. CEO/Integration Lead — monthly board update. Cross-functional workstreams — weekly standup. All-hands — monthly during first 90 days.

escalation_timeline.t_pre_close: Integration planning — Day 1 readiness prep, cultural assessment, systems mapping, org design draft, retention packages identified
escalation_timeline.t0_day_1: Close announced → Day 1 systems live → Joint all-hands → Customer email → Brand decision announced
escalation_timeline.t1_30d: Org design announced → Role matching complete → Retention packages offered → Systems integration begun → 100-day plan published
escalation_timeline.t30_90d: Systems integration (wave 1) → Revenue synergy tracking → Cultural integration activities → Executive roadshows
escalation_timeline.t90_100d: 100-day review → Milestone assessment → Course correction → Next phase planning → Org stability check
